items.title: How does a VAT loan work?

expanded_element.title: VAT loans – what they are and how do you get one
expanded_element.description: Once your business has been approved for a VAT loan, the lender will pay the amount directly to HMRC. You will then need to pay back the lender the loaned amount plus the agreed interest in monthly instalments.

items.title: Can you claim VAT back on a business loan?

expanded_element.title: Understanding VAT Loans in the UK - Iwoca
expanded_element.description: However, while you can't claim back VAT on a loan, as no VAT is charged, it's good to know that interest paid on business loans is tax-deductible, as it's treated as a business expense.

items.title: What can I do if I can't afford my VAT bill?

expanded_element.title: What happens if I cannot pay the VAT bill? - BTG Begbies Traynor
expanded_element.description: If you cannot pay your VAT bill, you must contact HMRC immediately to the possibility of entering into a Time to Pay (TTP) arrangement, which allows you to spread payments over time. Filing your VAT return on time is essential even if you cannot pay the amount due, as this avoids additional penalties.
